page.description: RabbitMQ management plugin. RabbitMQ MQTT servers show a detection badge and connection-status panel in the MQTT settings, and broker users can be managed (create, edit, permissions, delete) from the MQTT server detail view.

users.title: RabbitMQ users
users.deleteDescription: Delete the RabbitMQ user {{name}}? Connected clients using this account will be disconnected and its permissions removed.

form.defaults: Allows the user to publish and subscribe over MQTT: configure {{configure}}, write/read {{write}}.
form.passwordRequired: Password is required when creating a user.
